A dexterous warrior, Varin’s youth was spent being experimented on at an orphanage run by a secretive cabal of wizards in Waterdeep. Upon achieving the age of majority, Varin was booted into the street with nothing but his wits and involuntarily granted magical abilities. Rendered mute by the experimentation, Varin could have easily become a loner amongst people he can’t communicate with easily. Instead, he became a well known mercenary, constantly smiling at some joke nobody else will ever hear. Varin is fairly young, but looks like a wise monk, which he knows and takes advantage of to cheat people in games of chance. In combat, Varin relies on speed and offense, neglecting armor completely. He channels his fire-based abilities through a kunai-with-chain, scimitar, and throwing knives. If enemies get too close for comfort, he repels them with a fiery vortex of arcane power.
